name: Inaba Touya
source:
The protagonist of the story, a second-year student at the private Seiseki Academy. He has excellent grades, good athletic ability, and flawless looks; at first glance, he appears to be perfect. However, he has an unexpected weakness, which he has always tried to hide from those around him. After an incident while playing in the past, he became a terrible swimmer, and now he never goes near water, even for class or play (bathing is an exception, of course). Before enrolling at the academy, he lived with his family in the countryside, but now he lives alone.
